description: Discover the best hotels in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Central Hong Kong Escape near Kowloon Park with Two Restaurants & Rooftop Pool Access
hotels.description: Step outside the Gateway Hotel and you're immediately in the heart of bustling Hong Kong - the harbour glittering at the end of Canton Road, Harbour City's shops and restaurants stretching in every direction and the Star Ferry just a short walk away. Tsim Sha Tsui MTR station is just minutes on foot, unlocking the rest of the city. When you're not sampling street food, shopping or wandering the waterfront, enjoy international buffet spreads at Three on Canton. As the sun sets over Hong Kong, pull up a spot on Be on Canton's alfresco terrace for cocktails and light bites. You'll also have access to a pool and fitness centre at the neighbouring Marco Polo Hongkong Hotel.

hotels.title: Shangri-La Hong Kong Harbourfront Break with Michelin-Starred Restaurant
hotels.description: Stay in an unbeatable harbourfront location at Kowloon Shangri-La in Hong Kong, a five-star landmark hotel that boasts a prime spot along the waterfront of Victoria Harbour. When it comes to gastronomic delights, there's no need to search further than the walls of your hotel thanks to four exquisite dining options onsite, including the Michelin-starred Shang Palace, serving a mouthwatering range of Cantonese dishes and equipped with a dedicated wine cellar and a 20-seat grand private dining room. If you're on the go, stop by Baked by Shangri-La for homemade bread and pastries. For a tipple or two, the Lobby Lounge is the perfect spot to relax under crystal chandeliers while live music and an extensive cocktail menu will keep you entertained. There's always something to do in Kowloon. Whether you're keen to explore the Hong Kong Museum of History, go shopping, laze under a tree at the city park or peruse the stalls at the Temple Street Night Market, the hotel is perfectly placed to tick off all the must-see and must-dos on your list.

hotels.title: Hong Kong Harbourside Glamour with Restaurant, Bar & Lounge
hotels.description: Experience the best of Hong Kong with a stay at the harbourfront Prince Hotel Hong Kong, perfectly positioned in the vibrant Tsim Sha Tsui district. Located just moments from the city's best museums, restaurants and shopping areas, this contemporary retreat places the best of Hong Kong at your fingertips. Unwind in spacious, well-appointed rooms and elevate your stay with cocktails at the exclusive Continental Club Lounge. Savour Asian favourites at SAVVY before exploring cultural landmarks, strolling the waterfront or diving into the surrounding culinary scene. Delivering stylish comfort and distinctive local flair, this sleek sanctuary is the perfect base for discovering the city.
